title: Mixed conditionals and hypotheses
grammar: Mixed conditionals, I wish / If only

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn mixed conditionals and structures with I wish / If only to express hypotheses and regrets.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. I wish I had more time. If only I had listened. Notice how conditionals can mix past and present.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: If I ___ born earlier, I would be retired now.
phases.explanation: Mixed conditional: past condition, present result. Use had + past participle.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences with I wish about things you would change in your life.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I wish I ___ how to play the piano.
phases.explanation: For present regrets we use I wish + Past Simple.
